owner_authorization: 允许推送 origin/main；执行 P2-R 只读根因审计，只使用 P1 immutable dataset，不训练、不读 holdout、不修改 ACTIVE、不部署、不下单，完成后停止。
question: Why did the pre-registered P2 L2 validation fail, and does the evidence support a threshold-only fix or a new training experiment?

allowed_reads: the exact P1 immutable CSV and manifest above
the exact P2 result, feature-importance, and matched-pair artifacts above
repository code and pre-holdout protocol metadata

fixed_diagnostics.folds: reuse the five pre-registered P2 walk-forward test folds without outcome-dependent boundary changes
fixed_diagnostics.pressure_net: net_ret_swap_taker - 0.0005 additional slippage; P1 already contains 0.001 taker round trip
fixed_diagnostics.feature_association: Spearman rho per immutable 28-feature column and per P2 test fold
fixed_diagnostics.feature_stability_rule: finite rho with the same non-zero sign in at least 4/5 test folds and absolute median rho >= 0.03
fixed_diagnostics.label_regime_shift_rule: max-minus-min fold TP-before-SL rate >= 0.10 or all-row pressure-net mean range >= 0.005
fixed_diagnostics.model_collapse_rule: best_iteration <= 1 or calibration distinct_scores < 100 in at least 2/5 folds
fixed_diagnostics.calibration_transport_rule: fixed-gate test pass rate falls outside 0.08..0.12 in at least 3/5 folds
fixed_diagnostics.threshold_exoneration_rule: fold-local exact top-decile pressure-net is <= 0 in at least 4/5 folds
fixed_diagnostics.matched_control_rule: P2 matched-control lift is not significant when exact UTC-week sign-flip p >= 0.01
fixed_diagnostics.missingness_rule: report every feature with non-finite or missing values; do not impute

decision_rules.single_variable_training_followup_suppor: only if at least one feature meets feature_stability_rule and evidence is not solely from the collapsed full-model importance
decision_rules.otherwise: stop after P2-R and do not preregister or run another training phase

evidence_class: descriptive_and_diagnostic_preholdout_only; no causal claim; no deployment or holdout proof
